info.title: Task Boards API
info.description:
REST API for personal and shared task & reminder boards.

**How to try it here:**
1. `POST /api/auth/login` → "Try it out" → Execute (demo user: `dana@example.com` / `Demo1234!` after running the seed).
2. Copy `data.accessToken` from the response.
3. Click **Authorize** (top right), paste the token, click Authorize.
4. Call any protected endpoint.

All responses use `{ "success": true, "data": ... }` or `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message" } }`.
All ids are UUID strings. All date-times are ISO 8601 in UTC (e.g. `2026-11-02T09:00:00.000Z`). Date-only values use `YYYY-MM-DD`.

**Board permissions:** PRIVATE board — only the owner. SHARED board — owner and members can view; members can edit tasks/reminders only when the board is open (`isOpen: true`); only the owner manages settings, share link and members.
A board you are not allowed to view returns **404**. A board you can view but not edit returns **403** on writes.

bearerAuth.description: Paste the accessToken returned by /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register

details.description: Optional extra information (validation issues, conflicting times, ...)

BoardAccess.description: The current user's permissions on the board — use it to show/hide buttons in the UI

canManage.description: May change settings, share link and members (owner only)

isOpen.description: SHARED boards: members may edit. Always false for PRIVATE.

shareToken.description: Only returned to the owner of a SHARED board

audience.description: BOARD = everyone on the board, SELECTED = creator + assignees only

startAt.description: Timed task start or reminder time

blocksTime.description: true only for timed tasks that are not DONE

password.description: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a digit

CreateTaskInput.description: Schedule options: none (no date fields), date-only (`dueDate`), or timed (`startAt` + `endAt`). A timed, not-DONE task is checked for overlaps with the time of its assignees (or of the creator if nobody is assigned) → 409 TIME_CONFLICT.

assigneeIds.description: Board owner/members. Required (non-empty) when audience is SELECTED

UpdateTaskInput.description: Send only the fields to change. Send `null` to clear a field. Sending startAt/endAt clears dueDate and vice versa. `assigneeIds` replaces the whole list.

to.description: End of the search range (max 92 days after from)

assignedUserId.description: Board owner/member to find time for. Defaults to the logged-in user

post.description: Owner or member. Finds free slots for `assignedUserId` (default: me), who must be the board owner or a member. Busy time = that user's timed, not-DONE tasks on ALL boards. Reminders, date-only tasks, unscheduled tasks and DONE tasks are ignored. Slots are cut back-to-back from each free gap inside [from, to), earliest first. Nothing is saved — create the task with POST /api/boards/{boardId}/tasks.
